name: wm-shipped-hotfixes
summary: The two hotfixes the shipped WorldManager.exe carries in its .custom section (a null check in CParserClient::fc_NC_FRIEND_DEL_REQ, an index guard in CWMZoneSessionManager::GetServiceMapCanParty), for a WorldManager RELINKED from fiesta-decomp source - whose base keeps the original pre-patch code.
status: BUILT 2026-11-12 from the stock exe's .custom bytes (0xA30000 / 0xA30022), reproduced byte for byte. Apply with --reloc <WorldManager.reloc.json> to a relinked exe; the stock exe already has them (its sites then fail the expected-bytes check, so nothing is written twice).
why: The shipped exe was binary-patched after linking: a .custom section at 0xA30000 holds two caves, and two
jumps in .text lead to them. fiesta-decomp's base source is the original compile (docs/WorldManager-
equivalence.md: #19584, #19062), so a relinked exe needs them re-applied until a source branch carries them.
1. fc_NC_FRIEND_DEL_REQ +0xD6: `mov eax, [ecx]; mov ecx, [esi+2]` (5 B) -> jmp cave:
test eax, eax ; je back ; mov eax, [ecx] ; mov ecx, [esi+2] ; jmp back     (back = site + 5)
- the friend entry pointer in eax is checked before it is dereferenced.
2. GetServiceMapCanParty +0x29: `cmp ebx, [edi] ; jne +0xF ; mov ebx, [eax-4]` (7 B) -> jmp cave ; nop ; nop:
cmp edi, 0x42 ; jge out2 ; cmp ebx, [edi] ; jne ne2 ; jmp cont2 ; out2: jmp out2
- an index guard (edi < 0x42) before the map row is read. NOTE, reproduced as shipped: the cave returns to
cont2 = site + 7, so the original `mov ebx, [eax-4]` of the window is not executed - the following
`cmp ebx, [edi+4]` compares the [eax-8] value loaded before the window. The stack has run this way.

new_section.name: .wmhotfix
new_section.note: The two caves, at +0 and +0x22 as in the shipped .custom section.

edits.why: FRIEND_DEL_REQ: jmp to cave 1 (opcode, replaces mov eax,[ecx])
FRIEND_DEL_REQ: jmp to cave 1 (rel32, replaces the rest of mov eax,[ecx] and mov ecx,[esi+2])
GetServiceMapCanParty: jmp to cave 2 (opcode, replaces cmp ebx,[edi])
GetServiceMapCanParty: jmp to cave 2 (rel32, replaces the rest of cmp, jne +0xF, mov ebx,)
GetServiceMapCanParty: nop nop (the rest of mov ebx,[eax-4])

code.why: cave 1: null check of the friend entry, then the two moved loads, back
cave 2: index guard, the moved compare, back (as shipped: to site2 + 7)
